sources.citation: OLAC: resources in and about the Solos language (language-archives.org/language/sol, as of 2025-11-04, via Wayback).
sources.note: Catalogue only: the only 'language descriptions' are the two SIL items above; other holdings are Capell 1963 survey wordlist/texts (PARADISEC AC2-NSBSOLOG101), Allen & Hurd 1964 Bougainville survey (AC2-NSBCVOC201), Palmer 2006 recording (BP3-004), Ross 1980 wordlists (MR1-048).

sources.citation: SIL-PNG archive catalogue page, entry 89746 (Organised Phonology Data: Solos) and old SIL-PNG Solos language page (2015 snapshot: 'Nothing yet available').

sources.citation: Doyle, Larry [Lawrance] (data checked with James Tavish). 2021 [created 2011-2021]. Organised Phonology Data: Solos [sol], Autonomous Region of Bougainville. Ukarumpa: SIL-PNG. 9 pp. Draft ms., SIL Language & Culture Archives entry 89746.
sources.note: Nothing. Read in full (inventory, wordlists, Length, Syllable Patterns, phonological/orthographic conventions, sample text): no stress/accent/tone/suprasegmental statement at all. A single phonetic form carries a stress mark, [pɑ.ˈʧik] /paʧik/ 'pluck fruit' (p.2); every other transcription is unmarked.

sources.note: For Petats proper (not Solos), sec. 4 p.65: 'Tone and stress have not been found to be contrastive.' No location rule. Does not treat Solos.
